Stress with Suffixes: Two Syllables Before the Suffix

There are many suffixes in English. Suffixes are morphemes that are added to the end of words to create a new variation of the word.
The suffix will determine where to put the stress in the word.
Let's look at the suffixes -phy, -fy and -an.
The stress falls on the syllable that is two syllables before the suffix.
Look at the chart for examples. Practice saying the words aloud, stressing the correct syllable.

Consonant clusters are common in English spelling, making the pronunciation of some words difficult for non-native speakers. This is when three (or even two) consonant sounds appear together in a word.

The word create begins with a consonant cluster: the two consonant sounds [c] [r].
The word spread begins with a consonant cluster: the three consonant sounds [s] [p] [r].

Over the past 5,000 years, art in Nepal has taken many forms and has experienced many influences. In early Nepal, most of the arts were derived from the Vedic philosophy and influences.
In general, Nepalese art is based on the concept that our experiences can be divided into three separate but related groups: the senses, the emotions, and the spirit, and that we need to satisfy all three groups.
Nepalese art has been heavily influenced by Indian art. Indian artists bring these elements together, using symbolism that gives the art its unique energy and rhythm.
Over the centuries, Indian art has been influenced by Buddhism, Hinduism ,Jainism and Nepalese art has followed suit.

The coming of Islam spawned a whole new era of Indian architecture and art. Finally, the British spread their own Gothic and Roman influences and fused it with the Indian and Nepalese styles.
The cross-legged Buddha and the many-armed Hindu and Jain gods are figures often found in Nepalese painting and obsidian sculpture.
Other elements that are commonly seen in Nepalese art include the female body, spring trees, water, lions, and elephants.

Nepal is well-known for its beautiful jewelry and textiles. Nepalese jewelers still create jewelry using century-old techniques that have disappeared in other cultures.
Nepal is also famous for its beautiful silk, wool, and cotton textiles, including splendid, colorful woolen shawls from the Pokhara region that beautify many homes. Over the past 5,000 years, Nepalese artists and artisans have created some of the most interesting and beautiful architecture, sculpture, painting, and crafts the world has ever seen.
